title: Why pharma firms are betting billions on psychedelic drugs despite setbacks
title_zh: 尽管遭遇挫折，为何制药企业仍对迷幻药物押注数十亿美元
abstract: Regulatory pushback stalled the field. But researchers are optimistic about mind-altering drugs as potential treatments for depression and mood disorders.
abstract_zh: 监管阻力一度使该领域停滞不前。但研究人员对改变意识的药物作为抑郁症和情绪障碍的潜在治疗方法持乐观态度。
snippet: Regulatory pushback stalled the field. But researchers are optimistic about mind-altering drugs as potential treatments for depression and mood disorders.
